name: luh-influence-of-training-parameters-for-ipinn-accuracy-in-shape-sensing
notes:
The dataset contains results from an optimal sensor placement with differently trained iPINNs (physics-informed neural network for inverse problems) in shape sensing. The iPINNs are available at [1]. In the present dataset, the iPINN variants differ in the number of training iterations and the resampling interval of sensor configurations during the training. The following factor steps are investigated in the study:
- Number of training iterations: 30,000; 50,000; 100,000
- Resampling intervals every x iterations: 10, 50, 100

A short description of the results is given in the file "Description-and-Interpretation-of-OSP-Results.pdf", where plots visualise the training and optimisation results. The different *.zip files contain the generated *.txt files with the optimisation results of each individual in each generation.
